This interaction may modulate the activity of the G-protein-coupled receptor, potentially influencing cellular signaling pathways that are relevant to the growth and survival of SCCH-26 cells. The final score of 0.5121 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Nifurpirinol and SCCH-26.
